component.name: ElyTable
component.summary: Spreadsheet editor for XLSX, ODS and CSV files

description.p: This is a community package of ElyTable, maintained independently. It repackages the official upstream Linux build unmodified.

ElyTable is the spreadsheet app of Ely Office, a set of offline-first desktop apps written in Rust with GPUI. It opens and saves XLSX, ODS, XLS, CSV and TSV files, with LibreOfficeKit as the calculation engine.

ul.li: Formulas, formatting and multiple sheets, calculated by LibreOfficeKit
Saves back to the original format; Save As writes a new file and leaves the original alone
Recovery points every 10 seconds while there are unsaved changes, kept only on this computer
Optional auto-save, zoom, printing and export

description.p: ElyTable works fully offline. The package shares the network only because opening a second file hands it to the window already open over a local connection. It can read and write your Documents and Downloads folders; other files are opened and saved through the file chooser, or from your file manager. Settings and recovery points live in ~/.var/app/ely.zacharyzhang.office.table.

To open files anywhere in your home directory by path: flatpak override --user --filesystem=home ely.zacharyzhang.office.table. Undo with flatpak override --user --reset ely.zacharyzhang.office.table.
In-app updates are left to Flatpak: new upstream releases arrive as Flatpak updates.
